known_outcome: Regulator position: dwellings with fuel-fired space or water heating appliances do not need make-up air if the appliances are mechanically vented or direct-vented as defined; Categories III and IV are treated differently in sensitivity to depressurization; forced-draft, power-vented and induced-draft systems may fall under the mechanically vented definition.
review_focus: Separates the appliance definition from the make-up air requirement
Asks for the appliance category and vent configuration evidence
Flags the B149.1 gas-code reference as a source to check
Does not say the installation complies
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
